messages:
maria: Heads-up - pushing kernel v3.14-quantized to night bucket in ~10m. This roll includes the new matmul microkernel + quant patch.
aj: copy. what's the pin/ttl plan?
maria: pin TTL 2h for the night window, deploybot sticky-pin enabled. if canary good, we'll lift pins next morning.
aj: ok. canary size?
maria: 2% global traffic, split eu/us 1%/1%.
sasha: noted. release notes drafted in /docs/release-notes/kernel-3.14.md — includes perf numbers and known perf caveat on seq_len>2048.
zane: added SLO monitors to the smoke run: 99p latency, p50 token/sec, and error-rate. hooking a rollback webhook to deploybot.
maria: rollback criteria I want in chat: 
- 99p latency > 200ms sustained for 3 consecutive 1-minute windows
- OR error rate delta +2pp vs baseline for 5 mins
- OR KV-cache OOM spike on canary machines (detected by kernel_oom metric)
aj: agree. also add automated TTL rescue: if pinned for >90min and canary still failing, auto-rollback and notify.
maria: yes — add that.
deploybot: DeployBot: starting canary rollout: kernel v3.14-quantized -> region eu-west-1 (slice id: s-789). canary size 1%
sasha: quick smoke checklist for ops: 
1) run `curl -sS https://smoke/api/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'`
2) check traces for delta in attention kernel time
3) verify per-route p95 < baseline + 50ms
(brief)
maria: posting the exact rollback command for ops: `deploybot rollback --release kernel@3.14 --scope=s-789`
zane: hooking alert channels: #eng-oncall + pager if SLO tripped and not acknowledged in 2m.
aj: small note — dedicated tenants on night bucket: do not include them in canary. we'll run a staged rollout after 8h if no issues.
sasha: updated release note to mention dedicated exclusion and canary metrics.
maria: quick log paste from staging matmul smoke (only snippet): 
```
[2026-03-20T23:11:04Z] matmul_kernel: exec_time=12ms seq_len=512
[2026-03-20T23:11:05Z] matmul_kernel: exec_time=240ms seq_len=4096 WARN input-slice-slow
[2026-03-20T23:11:06Z] kv_cache: used=1.2GB max=1.5GB
```
aj: that 240ms line worries me for long sequences. let's ensure the canary traffic is mostly seq_len<1024.
maria: yes, will pin canary traffic by prompt-length filter.
zane: deploying monitors — sample query for alert: 
`sum(increase(request_duration_bucket{le=\"+Inf\"}[1m])) by (le)` + compare 99p to baseline.
deploybot: DeployBot: canary progressed -> region us-east-1 slice s-790 (1%). no failures in first 3m.
sasha: ops, remember to run a small synthetic that hits seq_len 2048 for a sanity check (should be rare).
aj: if we see the seq_len regression in canary, do immediate rollback. no manual fiddling.
maria: agreed. i'm going to update the runbook with these points and attach the rollback snippet + quick triage checklist. will ping again at 5m and 15m marks. :eyes:
zane: copy. I'll leave the oncall awake for the early window.
aj: ping me if deploybot reports any pinned slices older than TTL.
deplybot_typo: (ignore)
deploybot: DeployBot: canary complete across eu/us slices (2%) — switching to hold. awaiting 15m metrics window.
aj: standing by.
sasha: adding note — after 15m hold, we run a broadened smoke over regional replica pools (non-dedicated) for 30m before staged expansion.
maria: thanks team. rolling the runbook now and will post final release note link when done.
aj: :thumbsup:
